description: Runs cargo audit and returns structured vulnerability data.

binPath.description: Path to compiled binary when mode=bin

deny.description: Minimum severity to treat as an error exit code (--deny <SEVERITY>). Default: any vulnerability triggers a non-zero exit.

file.description: Path to Cargo.lock file (--file <PATH>). Default: auto-detected.

fix.description: Automatically apply fixes for vulnerable dependencies (cargo audit fix). Updates Cargo.toml to use patched versions where available.

mode.description: Audit dependency tree (deps) or a compiled binary (bin)

noFetch.description: Skip fetching the advisory database, use local cache only (--no-fetch). Useful for offline or air-gapped environments.

name: audit

critical.description: Critical severity count (set in compact output)

fixesApplied.description: Number of fixes applied when using cargo audit fix

high.description: High severity count (set in compact output)

informational.description: Informational severity count (set in compact output)

low.description: Low severity count (set in compact output)

medium.description: Medium severity count (set in compact output)

mode.description: Audit mode: dependency tree (deps) or compiled binary (bin)

omittedVulnerabilities.description: Number of vulnerabilities omitted from the compact vulnerability list

total.description: Total vulnerability count (set in compact output)

unknown.description: Unknown severity count (set in compact output)

patched.description: Version requirements that fix the vulnerability

version.description: Installed version of the affected crate

title: Cargo Audit
